# Moth People
Winged humanoids who eat cloth and prefer cooler temperatures than humans.
Their [color=#a4885c]Insect Blood[/color] can't be metabolised from Iron like normal blood.
## Diet
- Can eat cotton, fabrics and clothing. - Cannot digest most foods other species consider edible.
## Benefits
- Wings provide [color=#1e90ff]better acceleration in zero gravity[/color], though they still need equipment to move in open space. - Take [color=#1e90ff]30% less Cold damage[/color].
## Drawbacks
- Take [color=#ffa500]15% more Heat damage, and catch on fire more easily[/color].
